protocol: Repeat the same questions in fresh sessions on the same search-enabled products, locale and mode. Retain date, exact answer, citations, source URLs, observation-time correctness and access errors. Do not join sessions or treat missing access as absence of citations.

metrics: verified Bing search data where accessible
caveats: AI answers vary; citations are not visits. GA4 direct traffic is not proof of AI referrals. GA4/GTM history-tracking account changes remain separate.
